difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a closed immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S and a geometric point zbar of Z with image xbar in X, the stalk (i_{small,*}F)_{zbar} equals the stalk F_{xbar} for every sheaf F on Z_etale (source lines 2615-2622). The proof chooses an etale neighbourhood (U, ubar) of xbar, replaces X and Z by U and Z x_X U using the base change formula for the pushforward, so that the situation becomes that of a closed immersion of schemes, and then invokes the corresponding scheme statement.
